_: The massed army (tools/army_spike.gd, scripts/army_vat.gdshader, scripts/army_banner.gdshader read it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). The host is commanded by regiment (Total War; docs/research/army-and-town-rules.md section 1): each regiment one VAT draw, one banner. units: the kinds of regiment, by name: role (melee stands in the front line, ranged behind it, cavalry on the wings), glyph on its banner (sword, spear, bow, horse, axe, engine), share of a host made up from a head count, men in one regiment, asset (the baked soldier's folder under res://assets/, tools/rig/README.md), freeciv (the Freeciv unit types that raise it; one regiment per company of the bridge's hosts), spacing (file, rank: units between men abreast and front to back; cavalry stands looser), speed (share of march.speed; a host marches at its slowest), and any of a mesh's fields to override them. meshes: per baked soldier folder: albedo (its paint, albedo.png for image-made units), team (rects: the palette cells in team.rects take the house colour, the KayKit way; mask: mask.png's white takes it, the rig pipeline's way), tracks (its baked clips by role: idle, walk, ready, attack, hit, death; rest is the pool men at ease play, name: weight). fallbackUnit: the kind a company of an unknown Freeciv type raises. man: the soldier's height in world units (the realm's people stand ~0.22). jitter.place, jitter.turn, jitter.size: how far a man stands off his mark, turns off the line (radians), and differs in size (share); jitter.rank: how far a rank bows forward or back along its length; jitter.step: how far a marching man is off his regiment's step (share of a stride). gap: units between regiments. column.files: men abreast on the march, low and high; column.rank: units between ranks on the march; column.gap: units between regiments nose to tail; column.order: roles front to back. line.frontage: men abreast in the line, by role, low and high; line.maxFront: regiments abreast in one row before another row forms behind; line.rowGap: units between rows; line.wingGap: units between the front row and its cavalry wings; line.reform: seconds a regiment takes to turn from column to line. march.speed: units a second; march.lead: units the column's head marches along the road before it reaches the muster; march.roadTries: how many nearby towns are asked for a road in. rest.every: seconds between a regiment's men shifting at ease, low and high; rest.men: how many shift each time, low and high; rest.turn: radians a man turns as he shifts. muster.cell: units to a cell of the field search; muster.clear: units kept clear round the seat's centre; muster.reach: how far out the field may run; muster.slope: the most a cell's ground may rise across it; muster.keepOff: no road or track within this share of a cell's width; muster.treeCost: what a tree on the line's ground costs; muster.missCost: what a cell of the line on unsuitable ground costs; muster.nearCost: what a cell further from the seat costs. banner.height: a regiment's banner pole in men's heights; banner.width: its cloth's reach in men's heights; banner.fixedFrom: camera distance beyond which banners keep their size on screen; banner.pips: strength pips under the flag. standard.scale: the army's standard against a regiment's banner. select.margin: units the ground rectangle reaches past a regiment; select.alpha: the rectangle's strength when selected; select.idle: its strength when not (0 hides it). far.at: camera distance beyond which the host shows as coloured blocks with its standard; far.back: the distance it turns back to men (no flicker in between). colours: crown (every regiment in the crown's colour, the art target's one-colour host) or houses (each regiment its house's, levies). spike.strength: in the spike only, the made-up regiments' strength, low and high (a real host's comes from its companies' hit points over hpFull). camera.tilt: degrees the army shot's lens sits below the map view's own pitch; camera.quarter: radians the lens stands off the line's front; camera.marchQuarter: off the column's heading. albedo: the paint's brightness under the realm's sun. team.rects: up to four KayKit palette cells (u0, v0, u1, v1, and how much of it takes the colour) that wear the house colour; team.shade: the colour's brightness over the cloth's own light. emblem.on: whether regiments wear their house's arms (the top of its banner, assets/heraldry) on the shield's face and the tabard's front; emblem.rect: where the arms sit in the banner picture (u0, v0, u1, v1); emblem.light: their paint's brightness under the sun. meshes.<dir>.emblem: up to two places on that soldier, in his rest pose (tools/emblem_probe.gd measures the pieces): center, size (across, up, depth), facing and up, facingMin (how square its face must turn to the facing), round (a roundel, for a round shield).
